source_artifact.name: Spy Pond FINAL_REFERENCE_STYLE DOCX
source_artifact.note: Consistent with existing repository practice for Bora-supplied source documents (BLUEPRINT.md Section 134): the binary is not stored; this record is the canonical description of the approved exemplar and its extracted contract.

supersedes.description: A previously reproduced résumé package (spawned for the Cable One application) drifted from Bora's approved presentation grammar in several ways captured as drift_patterns_rejected below. This record locks the corrected, explicitly Bora-approved grammar so future spawns do not reproduce that drift.

relationship_to_prior_doctrine.BLUEPRINT_134: RESUME_REFERENCE_STANDARD_V1 Fixed visual/QA contract (page size, one-column structure, typography scale, margins, section-rule headings, hyperlink rule) is restated and cross-referenced here, not redefined.
relationship_to_prior_doctrine.BLUEPRINT_140: BORA_RESUME_PACKAGE_STANDARD_SYNC_V1's DOCX-first default, real-hyperlink-object rule, requirement/JD-to-evidence crosswalk, and rendered-artifact QA authority are unchanged.
relationship_to_prior_doctrine.note: This record adds the presentation GRAMMAR (heading/section-order/entry-line structure) that §134 left as job-specific strategic variables. Only the grammar below is fixed; MGB-specific and Spy-Pond-specific wording/content choices remain job-specific.

summary_heading.description: The natural-language summary paragraph sits directly below the centered contact line with no section heading above it (not 'PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY', not any other generic heading label).

work_entry_grammar.description: One bold left-side line using 'Title | Employer' grammar with the date range right-aligned on the same line. Do not use an employer-first heading with a separate italic title line underneath as the canonical grammar.

education_grammar.description: Two-school gold-reference grammar: bold school name with the month-year date range right-aligned on the same line, and a degree line directly below it. Brandeis GPA presentation is retained when current Candidate Truth supports it; GPA is a truth-gated content choice, not itself part of the fixed grammar.

skills_grammar.description: Three natural recruiter-facing rows, not an arbitrary skill list and not internal Career OS taxonomy. Internal Career OS terminology (e.g. schema/enum/state names, module identifiers, EvidenceMatch labels) must never appear in candidate-facing skills text.

evidence_roster.rule: Bulmarma is not automatically inserted into the default roster and may replace space in the roster only when a role-specific Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk (BLUEPRINT.md Section 140.4) materially earns its inclusion for that application.

marketmind_heading_grammar.description: MarketMind uses the gold-reference heading grammar: a technology label alongside the project name, and a genuine right-side GitHub hyperlink (real hyperlink object per BLUEPRINT.md Section 134/140.5) when the project is included.

candidate_facing_prose_style.description: Mirrors the gold reference's human style: early-career role framing, concrete action/context/why wording, ordinary American English. No generic capability-stuffing summary. No internal/system jargon (e.g. 'human approval', 'operating system', other Career OS internal vocabulary) unless genuinely necessary and recruiter-natural in context.

typography.fallback_condition: only if Liberation Sans is unavailable, and only because Arial is metrically compatible

visual_metrics.relationship_to_134: These are the numeric instantiation of BLUEPRINT.md Section 134's Fixed visual/QA contract (page size, one-column structure, typography hierarchy, margins, thin-rule section headings) for the Spy Pond gold reference specifically; Section 134's contract itself is not redefined.

unchanged_doctrine: BLUEPRINT.md Section 140.6's submitted-artifact rendered QA authority

role_tailoring_boundary.must_preserve: the gold-reference presentation grammar above, unless an explicit employer requirement makes that grammar unusable for a specific application
role_tailoring_boundary.gold_reference_authority_scope: This record is a presentation-grammar, visual-metrics, and roster-structure authority only (heading presence/labels, section order, work-entry/education/skills line grammar, margins, typography, the default-roster mechanism). It is never a source of Candidate Truth: substantive factual content (wording, claims, evidence, metrics) must still trace only to approved Candidate Truth / claim-evidence lineage, exactly as before this lock.
must_never: invent or copy a resume fact merely because it appears in the Spy Pond exemplar's own MGB-specific wording or content
invent resume facts not present in approved Candidate Truth
change Candidate Truth, Match Truth, or qualification/pursuit logic
weaken the 92% page-utilization floor, DOCX-first rule, hyperlink-object rule, or rendered-artifact QA

drift_patterns_rejected.description: A generic 'PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY' (or equivalent generic) section heading placed above the summary paragraph.
Any default section order other than EDUCATION, SKILLS, WORK EXPERIENCE, RELEVANT PROJECT.
Work entries built as an employer-first bold heading line with a separate italic job-title line beneath it, instead of a single bold 'Title | Employer' line with right-aligned dates.
Internal Career OS terminology (schema/enum/state names, module identifiers, EvidenceMatch labels) appearing in candidate-facing skills text.
Bulmarma automatically inserted into the default evidence roster without a role-specific crosswalk earning its inclusion.
Candidate-facing prose (summary/bullets) using internal/system jargon such as 'human approval' or 'operating system' language where not genuinely necessary or recruiter-natural.

non_goals.reference: BLUEPRINT.md Section 133 build-economy gate; Section 134 Non-Goals
excludes: an automated grammar/style validator or linter beyond this doctrine record and its accompanying regression test
any change to Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, or schemas
any change to the protected resume master or resume patch/lineage architecture in .cursor/rules/resume.mdc
